out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. A CONTAINER OF RAID MULTI BUG SPRAY WAS FOUND IN THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA OF THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT RAID IS NOT ALLOWED TO BE USED IN COMMERCIAL KITCHENS AND IS HOME USE ONLY. PIC THREW AWAY SPRAY CAN OF RAID.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REPLACED PAPER TOWELS

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut lettuce 59F, water kimchi 61F out on the counter for 1 hour
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC PLACED LETTUCE AND KIMCHI IN THE REFRIGERATOR AND AGREED TO KEEP THEM REFRIGERATED.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS WITH GLOVES ON.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS EXPLAINED PROPER HAND WASHING. EMPLOYEE WASHED THEIR HANDS PROPERLY.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS EXPLAINED HANDS MUST BE WASHED AT THE HAND SINK. EMPLOYEE WASHED THEIR HANDS AT THE HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the kitchen being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED EQUIPMENT.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed food stored on the floor in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed the concentration of chlorine in the chemical dish machine at 0ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET UP 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AND AGREED NOT TO USE DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: chemical dish machine (chlorine was observed at 0ppm)
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC WILL PROVIDE AN INVOICE WHEN THE DISH MACHINE HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed a staff member rinse her gloved hands at the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE STAFF MEMBER PROPER HAND WASHING PROCEDURES TO INCLUDE HOW AND WHERE. STAFF MEMBER RE-WASHED HER HANDS CORRECTLY.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed rinsing her gloves hands in a food preparation sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER THAT ALL SINKS HAVE A PURPOSE AND HAND WASHING SHALL ONLY BE ACCOMPLISHED AT A HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) OBSERVED PREPARED FOODS STORED INSIDE A REFRIGERATOR FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS WITHOUT A DATE. THIS COULD INCLUDE LEFTOVER BREAKFAST FOODS, SOUPS, COOKED VEGETABLES, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED LABELING AND DATE MARKING WITH THE PERSON IN CHARGE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 12/6/2024. YOUNGS HEALTHCARE SENIOR CTR (Inspection Date: 11/26/2024) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed Chlorox wipes stored directly next to dry seasonings at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. EHS HAD THE PERSON IN CHARGE MOVE THE CHEMICALS TO A SEPARATE LOCATION.

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Observed an employee’s personal medication on the same work surface as food for day care residents.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO STORE HER PERSONAL MEDICATION SEPARATELY. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE TO CREATE A SPACE IN THE DRY STORAGE CLOSET FOR STAFF TO STORE ALL PERSONAL ITEMS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: Observed no digital food thermometer to check temperatures of foods being cooked, cooled, held, or reheated.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE TO ORDER A DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER. ENSURE IT HAS ARRIVED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold hot holding equipment: 1) OBSERVED THE HOME STANDARD KENMORE REFRIGERATOR IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA WITH NO THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE PERSON IN CHARGE THAT THIS UNIT IS NOT A COMMERCIAL REFRIGERATOR. PLEASE USE ANY HOME STYLE REFRIGERATORS FOR STORAGE OF EMPLOYEE FOOD ONLY AND ANY FOOD USED FOR THE DAY CARE RESIDENT SHALL BE PLACED IN THE COMMERCIAL 2DOOR UNIT IN THE KITCHEN. LABEL THE HOME STYLE REFRIGERATOR(S) IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA “EMPLOYEE USE ONLY” BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. YOUNGS HEALTHCARE SENIOR CTR (Inspection Date: 11/26/2024) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food stored in direct contact with the floor in the dry storage closet.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE TO ORDER MORE NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO GET FOOD OFF THE FLOOR. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) OBSERVED BOWLS USED TO DISPENSE BULK FOODS LIKE RICE AND DRY SEASONINGS, 2) OBSERVED MEASURING CUPS USED TO DISPENSE DRY SEASONINGS AND THE HANDLE OF THE MEASURING CUP WAS LAYING IN THE SPICES.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED AND SHOWED STAFF PROPER IN-USE UTENSIL STORAGE. EHS ALSO DISCUSSED THE UTENSILS SHALL BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED EVERY 24 HOURS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed cleaned and sanitized utensils and large pots in both the kitchen and dry storage areas that are not that stored inverted.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE PERSON IN CHARGE THAT ALL CLEANED, SANITIZED AND AIR DRIED UTENSILS AND EQUIPMENT SHALL BE STORED INVERTED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers such as tofu containers, garlic containers, etc were observed reused for the storage of other foods.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS DISCUSSED AND SHOWED THE PERSON IN CHARGE THE TYPES OF CONTAINERS THAT ARE DESIGNED FOR REUSE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: 1) WOOD PALLET IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA USED TO STORE CLEANED AND SANITIZED LARGE POTS.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS SHARED WITH THE PERSON IN CHARGE NSF APPROVED DUNNAGE RACKS TO REPLACE THE WOOD PALLETS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: 1) GROCERY STORE OR TAKE HOME PLASTIC BAGS USED FOR FOOD STORAGE IN REFRIGERATORS AND/OR FREEZERS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE PERSON IN CHARGE THE CORRECT TYPES OF BAGS OR FOOD CONTAINERS ALLOWED FOR USE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed a spray nozzle attached to the threaded faucet of the mop sink and the system is under constant pressure.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE TO REMOVE THE HOSE WITH SPRAY NOZZLE UNTIL THE APPROVED PRESSURE BLEEDING DEVICE IS RECEIVED. EHS SHOWED THE PERSON IN CHARGE A PICTURE OF THE APPROVED PRESSURE BLEEDING DEVICE. MANAGER WILL ORDER.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Observed the downstairs men’s employee restroom door not self closing.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE TO RE-INSTALL THE SELF CLOSING DOOR HINGE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Toilet Room, Kept Closed
violations.observation: Observed that toilet room doors are being kept open.
violations.corrective_action: Keep toilet room doors closed to prevent insect and rodent entrance and the associated spread of potential disease. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE TO KEEP ALL RESTROOM DOORS CLOSED UNLESS ACTIVELY CLEANING THE FACILITIES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered trash can in the downstairs ladies employee restroom stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE TO GET A COVERED TRASH CAN FOR THE LADIES’ EMPLOYEE RESTROOM STALL BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen walls and fans are not clean.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE TO CLEAN THE WALLS AND FANS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
